ارتعفت (form VIII)

# اِرْتَعَفْتَ (irtaʕafta) /ir.ta.ʕaf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# اِرْتَعَفْتِ (irtaʕafti) /ir.ta.ʕaf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# اِرْتَعَفَتْ (irtaʕafat) /ir.ta.ʕa.fat/: third-perso
